Khi bạn bị mất thẻ ATM, hoặc cần phải rú.en: When you lose your ATM card, or you need to withdraw a large amount of money, then withdrawing your Agribank ID is the fastest option. In addition, the case of withdrawing money from the savings register also requires identification or identification and to the bank where the book is opened for withdrawal.
Khi bạn bị mất thẻ ATM, hoặc cần phải rú.zh: 当你失去你的自动取款机卡, 或者你需要取出一大笔钱, 然后取出你的AgribankID是最快的选择。 此外,从储蓄登记册中取出钱款的情况也需要身份证明或身份证明,并需要向开户的银行取出。

Khi mất thẻ ATM thì phương pháp rút tiền.en: When you lose the ATM card, the method of withdrawing the Agribank ID is the simplest way for you to cash out. Additionally, if you register Internet Services Banking or have a bank account link to electronic wallets, you can also withdraw money via an electronic wallet.
Khi mất thẻ ATM thì phương pháp rút tiền.zh: 失去自动取款机卡后,收回Agribank身份证的方法是最简单的兑现方式. 此外,如果您注册了互联网服务银行或有银行账户链接到电子钱包,您也可以通过电子钱包提取资金。

Khi rút tiền bằng chứng minh thư agriban.en: When withdrawing agribank ID, you need to bring your ID with you. Note using the expiration certificate. Old ID, torn or out of information should not be used.
Khi rút tiền bằng chứng minh thư agriban.zh: 收回农业银行的身份证时,你需要带上身份证 使用过期证书的说明。 不得使用旧身份证、被撕裂或断绝信息。

Khi đến ngân hàng, bạn sẽ được hướng dẫn.en: When you arrive at the bank, you will be instructed to select services to perform and draw the automatic number. Compensating each service is a door with employees who will handle that service for you. Currently, most banks deploy the system to take such an automatic number. Therefore, you need to get the number as soon as you get to the bank to avoid waiting.
Khi đến ngân hàng, bạn sẽ được hướng dẫn.zh: 到达银行后,将指示您选择执行的服务并绘制自动号码. 补偿每项服务 都有一个门 员工会为你处理服务。 目前,大多数银行都使用这个系统来使用这样的自动号码。 因此,你需要得到的号码 一旦你得到银行避免等待。

So với các hình thức rút tiền tự động nh.en: Compared to automatic withdrawals at the ATM, withdrawals through the electronic bank... withdrawals of Agribank IDs were not as convenient. In order to get the money out of the certificate at the bank, you need staff support. At that time, the bankers had to handle more tasks.
So với các hình thức rút tiền tự động nh.zh: 和自动取款机的自动取款相比,通过电子银行取款... 取阿格里银行的身份证并不方便. 为了在银行拿到钱,你需要员工的支持. 当时,银行家们不得不处理更多的任务.

Tuy nhiên, không phải ai cũng có khả năn.en: However, not everyone is capable of opening an electronic wallet. So the method of withdrawing the Agribank ID is still chosen. Moreover, when a large withdrawal of money from the account comes the bank withdrawing evidence that the certificate will be quicker and more convenient.
Tuy nhiên, không phải ai cũng có khả năn.zh: 然而,并非每个人都能打开电子钱包。 因此撤回阿格里班克ID的方法仍然被选择. 此外,当银行从账户提取大笔款项时,银行撤回证明证书会更快、更方便的证据。

Để rút tiền bằng chứng minh thư tại Agri.en: In order to cash the ID at Agribank, you need to get the time of the bank. Usually, banks only work during administrative hours. In order for the withdrawal to take place quickly and not take time to wait, you should withdraw money in the early morning period.
Để rút tiền bằng chứng minh thư tại Agri.zh: 为了兑现Agribank的身份证,你需要银行的时间。 通常银行只在行政时间工作. 为了让提款迅速进行,而不要花时间等待,你应该在清晨时间提款.

Để rút tiền trực tiếp tại ngân hàng, ngo.en: To withdraw cash directly at the bank, in addition to the ID, you can use your passport, civil identity identity, or other forms of paper that can verify the identity. However, it is best to use the ID.
Để rút tiền trực tiếp tại ngân hàng, ngo.zh: 在银行直接取出现金,除身份证外,您还可以使用护照,公民身份证明,或者能够验证身份的其他证件. 不过,最好使用身份证。

Để rút tiền, bạn cần xuất trình chứng mi.en: To cash out, you need to export your ID, fill out your withdrawal form. The banker will handle it very quickly so you can cash out. Even, for customers who need to withdraw the money will be given the votes to fill out before reaching the order to work with the traders.
Để rút tiền, bạn cần xuất trình chứng mi.zh: 为了兑现,你需要输出你的身份证, 填写你的退出表。 银行家会很快处理的 这样你就能兑现 即使对于需要取出钱款的顾客,在达成与贸易商合作的命令之前,也会得到填票.

Đối với các dịch vụ rút tiền bằng chứng.en: For services to withdraw money with different Agribank IDs and different amounts of money would be different. However, the fee is often not too large.
Đối với các dịch vụ rút tiền bằng chứng.zh: 使用不同的阿格里银行身份证和不同数额的资金提取货币的服务是不同的。 然而,费用往往并不高。

Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.en: For the cash withdrawal of Vietnam the ID at Agribank branch opens the account, the withdrawal fee will be 0-13% of the withdrawal.
Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.zh: 对于越南的提款, Agribank 分行的ID开户, 提款费将为提款的0-13%。

Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.en: For the cash withdrawal of Vietnam the ID at the other Agribank branch opened the account but in the branch of Hanoi County, Lake Chi Minh's withdrawal fee was 0.01% of the money needed withdrawal. The minimum is 15,000 and the maximum is $3,000,000.
Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.zh: 在越南现金提取方面, Agribank另一分行的ID开立了账户, 但在河内县分行, 奇明湖的提取费是所需提取资金的0.01%。 最低为一万五千元,最高为三百万元.

Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.en: For the cash withdrawal of Vietnam the ID at the other Agribank branch opened and other provinces, the municipality, the withdrawal fee was 0.02% -0.06% of the withdrawal required. The minimum is 20,000 and the maximum is $3,000,000.
Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.zh: 对于越南的现金提取,阿格里班克其他分行和其他省、市的身份证提取费为所需提取的0.02%-0.06%。 最低限额为2万元,最高限额为300万元.

Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.en: For the cash withdrawal of Vietnam the ID at the other Agribank branch opened the account, but the same province and municipality fee was 0.00% -0.02% of the withdrawal required. The minimum is 15,000 and the maximum is $3,000,000.
Đối với rút tiền mặt Việt Nam đồng bằng.zh: 对于越南的提款,Agribank另一分行的身份证开立了账户,但同一省市收费为所需提款的0.00%-0.02%。 最低为一万五千元,最高为三百万元.

Đối với rút tiền ngoại tệ USD bằng chứng.en: For the currency withdrawal of the US$$10 and at least $2. For other types of currency, this cost was 0.4% and at least $4. With the EUR bronze being 0.3% and the minimum fee is 2 EUR.
